note: Every open MCQ source considered for Med-OS (research 2026-10-26, licences read at their source; scripts/lib/sources.mjs checks this file). verdict: import (fetch-sources.mjs brings it in as pool candidates, which still face the flaw checks, the model review and the bar), in-app (already in the pool or the bank by another route), benchmark-only (used to measure, never shipped), reject. A licence that covers only a repository's code is said so.

sources.name: HEAD-QA v1 (English), medicine
sources.what: Spanish MIR residency exam 2013 to 2016, medicine paper, machine-translated by the dataset's authors; 4 to 5 options, no explanations
sources.licence: Reuse with attribution (Ministerio de Sanidad, Spain)
sources.terms: The meaning may not be changed; cite the source; give the date of the documents' last update (14 January 2019)
sources.credit: HEAD-QA (Vilares and Gómez-Rodríguez, ACL 2019): Spanish MIR exam question, Ministerio de Sanidad, as translated by the dataset's authors; documents last updated 14 January 2019
sources.why: real exam questions with a reuse grant; 2017 is left out because its answer keys look taken from another paper (6 of 9 sampled implausible), and questions that need an image are left out

sources.name: MedQA US 4-option
sources.what: USMLE-style questions collected from prep material
sources.why: in the pool as usmle-resource (data/benchmarks), its licence shown; the founder chose to admit it with the caveat that MIT covers the code

sources.name: MMLU professional medicine
sources.what: clinical vignettes collected from free online sources

sources.name: MedExpQA / Antidote CasiMedicos
sources.what: MIR clinical cases with doctors' explanations
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (CC0 in the GitHub repository)
sources.why: in the bank, adapted for Australian practice with its credit (scripts/import-medexpqa.mjs); the GitHub tarball is a second download path

sources.name: QUEST-AI (official USMLE Step 2 CK samples and GPT-4 look-alikes)
sources.why: sets the pool's bar; never committed (scripts/validate-mcq.mjs checks)
